QuestionStmt.S: Which among the following salts is NOT hydrolysed in water?

Solution.S: Salts from strong acid and strong base do not undergo hydrolysis. KNO₃ comes from KOH (strong base) and HNO₃ (strong acid), hence no hydrolysis. Na₂CO₃ (weak acid + strong base) hydrolyses. NH₄CN (weak acid + weak base) hydrolyses. KCN (weak acid + strong base) hydrolyses. Thus, KNO₃ is not hydrolysed. Correct option: C.
